text: OpenBackupMsgDatabase uses OpenDBFromFile and adds its listener itself so the folder can close the backup during OnAnnouncerGoingAway. This is an explicit caller responsibility, distinct from the normal FinishDBOpen pending-listener hook. Preserve that manual listener step when changing the backup opener. These observations are scoped to the cited accepted source and historical changes. Full Bugzilla and historical review timeline/inline discussion remain pending. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check was run.
title: Keep backup database listener ownership explicit
